title: Well worth the time and money.
text:
Wonderful experience, just like a local. Host was friendly and helpful.
A wealth of local knowledge and happy to share it.
author: Tanya_B

title: Loved this tour!
text: Gabby was great.  We learned a lot about the Granada area.  We visited 3 very interesting bars and the Food was delicious.
author: Charles_R

title: Great taste of Granada with a local
text: Gaby was a great host! She customized the tour to our needs and took us to out-of-the-way places. Would highly recommend!
author: shinrichs

title: Fantastic Tapas Tour with Gaby!
text:
Our tapas tour with Gaby was absolutely fantastic! She's not just a guide, she's a wealth of knowledge, and her friendly and approachable nature made the whole experience even better.

Gaby's expertise in all things tapas was evident from the get-go, and we felt comfortable asking her anything. Whether it was about the food we were trying or the history behind it, she had all the answers and shared them with enthusiasm.

Throughout the tour, Gaby took us to some incredible spots, each offering a unique and delicious taste of local cuisine.

But what really made the tour stand out was Gaby hers
author: brockb199

title: Wonderful Granada Tapas Tour!
text: Our guide, Gabby, was delightful and so open and informative.  We learned a lot, ate a lot, drank a good bit and laughed a whole lot!  We felt so fortunate to have had her guiding us on this tapas tour.
author: Steve

title: Wonderful Tapas and Wine Tour
text: This was a wonder tapas and wine/beer tour!!  Gaby is fun and very informative. We learned about Granada food and culture while enjoying Gaby’s great personality.  We felt like we made a new friend!
author: Michael_K

title: Highly recommend this tapas tour.
text: We had an excellent tapas tour with Gabby.  We tried tapas we might never have tried on our own.  She was also very knowledgeable about the different wines and beers from the region.  We now have the confidence to make our own dining decisions
author: Deborah_N

title: A great way to see Granada at night!
text: This was an excellent way to get a first impression of some bars in Granada. Gabriella was a fantastic guide full of interesting information and great tips. A very lovely evening!!
author: Brian_O

title: Don't miss out on a great night in Granada!
text: June is brilliant. She was able to combine our two groups so we could all be together and really made for one of the best experiences we had in Spain. She took us to three very different, but all special, places where we had fabulous tapas and wine. I can't recommend this tour highly enough!
author: Cathy_M

title: Amazing food.  Super friendly guide.
text: Great tour with fantastic guide.   Gabby made it feel like we were all friends out for a night on the town.   Super friendly with lots of local knowledge.   Great food and drink too.   Thoroughly enjoyed the experience.
author: johnlD2391NE
